fills.decision: on the close of the bar ending at the decision minute; entry at the open of the decision-minute bar
fills.target: a resting limit: fills at the target only if a later bar trades through it by at least 1 tick
fills.stop: a resting stop: fills at the stop, or at the bar open if the bar opens beyond it
fills.rounding: targets rounded toward the entry, stops away from it, to the tick grid
fills.flatten: at the open of the flatten-minute bar

costs: L3 = Topstep fees + 4 ticks per round trip ($3.22 MNQ); L1-L4 reported
luck: matched control: the same entry minutes and bracket distances (target and stop distance from entry), each leg with an independent random direction, simulated on the same bars; 500 draws

name: Fade inside the noise band (reversion to the open)
source: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (noise area: moves inside the band are noise) + JJ Simon (session open as fair price)

rule.session: 08:30-15:00 CT (12:00 on early-close days); decisions at the SC-FUT-0005 checks (every 30 min, 09:00..14:30; 11:30 last on early days)
rule.band: exactly SC-FUT-0005: sigma(check) = mean |close at check / 08:30 open - 1| over the previous 14 sessions (>= 10 values); upper = max(open, prev close) x (1 + sigma); lower = min(open, prev close) x (1 - sigma)
rule.short: flat, price above the open, price >= open + 0.5 x (upper - open) and price < upper: short; target = the 08:30 open; stop = upper
rule.long: mirror: price below the open, price <= open - 0.5 x (open - lower) and price > lower: long; target = open; stop = lower
rule.position: one at a time; a new entry only at a later check after an exit; at most 3 entries per day
rule.exit: target, stop, or flatten at 15:00 (12:00 early)
